show.description: Karan, the secret heir of a powerful business empire, hides his identity and comes as a simple lawyer to propose to Sara. But Sara accepts Neel’s proposal, and Karan is humiliated and thrown out in front of everyone. Years later, when Sara is falsely accused and trapped in a cruel marriage, Karan returns with his true power to save her and expose the truth.
